= BITwiki Deployment Guide: Production Implementation =

== Executive Summary

This guide provides step-by-step instructions for deploying BITwiki book matter to a production MediaWiki instance with Semantic MediaWiki (SMW) enabled.

'''Prerequisites:'''
* MediaWiki 1.39+ installed
* PHP 8.1+ with required extensions
* MySQL 8.0+ or PostgreSQL 13+
* SMW 4.1+ installed and configured
* Administrative access to wiki

----
== 1. Pre-Deployment Checklist

=== 1.1 System Requirements

| Component | Minimum | Recommended |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| PHP | 8.1 | 8.2 |
| MediaWiki | 1.39 | 1.41 |
| SMW | 4.1 | 4.1.1 |
| Database | MySQL 8.0 | MariaDB 10.6 |
| Memory | 2GB | 4GB |
| Storage | 10GB | 50GB |

=== 1.2 Required Extensions

'''Core Extensions:'''
* Semantic MediaWiki (SMW)
* ParserFunctions
* Cite
* SyntaxHighlight
* TemplateStyles

'''Recommended Extensions:'''
* VisualEditor
* WikiEditor
* CodeEditor
* ConfirmEdit (CAPTCHA)
* AbuseFilter

'''BITwiki-Specific:'''
* Semantic Forms (for structured input)
* Page Forms (for template-based editing)
* Header Tabs (for organized display)

=== 1.3 Backup Current System

```bash
# Backup database
mysqldump -u wikiuser -p wikidb > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d).sql

# Backup files
tar -czf wiki_files_$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz /var/www/html/wiki/

# Verify backups
ls -lh backup_*.sql wiki_files_*.tar.gz
```

----
== 2. SMW Configuration

=== 2.1 Enable SMW

'''LocalSettings.php:'''
```php
// Load SMW
wfLoadExtension( 'SemanticMediaWiki' );
enableSemantics( 'bitwiki.org' );

// SMW Settings
$smwgConfigFileDir = __DIR__ . '/data';
$smwgEnabledQueryFeatures = SMW_QUERY_ALL;
$smwgQMaxSize = 5000;
$smwgQMaxDepth = 10;
```

=== 2.2 Configure Property Types

'''Create Property: namespace pages:'''
```bash
# Run SMW setup
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/setupStore.php

# Rebuild data
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/rebuildData.php
```

=== 2.3 Optimize Performance

```php
// Enable query cache
$smwgQueryResultCacheType = CACHE_ANYTHING;
$smwgQueryResultCacheLifetime = 3600;

// Enable property statistics
$smwgPropertyStatistics = true;

// Configure job queue
$wgJobRunRate = 10;
```

----
== 3. Template Deployment

=== 3.1 Upload Templates

'''Method 1: Direct File Upload'''
```bash
# Copy template files
scp hyperion/book-matter/schema-matter/templates/*.wiki \
  user@server:/var/www/html/wiki/extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/import/

# Import via maintenance script
php maintenance/importTextFile.php \
  --title "Template:Infobox_Concept" \
  --overwrite \
  extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/import/Infobox_Concept.wiki
```

'''Method 2: Wiki Import'''
```bash
# Create XML dump
php maintenance/dumpBackup.php --current > templates.xml

# Import on target
php maintenance/importDump.php templates.xml
```

=== 3.2 Verify Template Installation

'''Checklist:'''
* [ ] Template:Infobox_Concept loads without errors
* [ ] Template:Epistemic_Marker displays correctly
* [ ] Template:Document_Header includes properly
* [ ] SMW properties populate in templates
* [ ] No transclusion errors in logs

'''Test Query:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Template:+]]
|?Has title
|format=ul
}}
```

----
== 4. Property Deployment

=== 4.1 Create Property Pages

'''Automated Creation:'''
```bash
# Generate property pages from definitions
php maintenance/createPropertyPages.php \
  --source hyperion/book-matter/schema-matter/SMW_Property_Definitions.md \
  --namespace "Property:"
```

'''Manual Creation:'''
# Navigate to `Property:Has confidence`
# Add content: `[[Has type::Number]]`
# Save and verify type assignment

=== 4.2 Configure Property Constraints

'''Range Constraints:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Number]]
[[Has property constraint::Range: 0.0-1.0]]
[[Has description::Numerical confidence score]]
```

'''Allowed Values:'''
```mediawiki
[[Has type::Text]]
[[Has allowed value::Axiomatic]]
[[Has allowed value::Established]]
[[Has allowed value::Emerging]]
[[Has allowed value::Hypothetical]]
[[Has allowed value::Contested]]
```

=== 4.3 Rebuild Property Data

```bash
# Rebuild all semantic data
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/rebuildData.php -v

# Update property statistics
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/updatePropertyStatistics.php
```

----
== 5. Content Deployment

=== 5.1 Import Book Matter

'''Step 1: Prepare Content'''
```bash
# Convert markdown to wiki markup
pandoc hyperion/book-matter/constitutional/*.md -t mediawiki -o constitutional.wiki

# Process frontmatter
python scripts/extract_frontmatter.py constitutional.wiki
```

'''Step 2: Import Pages'''
```bash
# Import with proper categories
php maintenance/importTextFile.php \
  --title "BITwiki_Constitution" \
  --overwrite \
  constitutional/BITwiki_Constitution.wiki
```

'''Step 3: Verify Import'''
```bash
# Check page exists
curl "https://bitwiki.org/api.php?action=query&titles=BITwiki_Constitution&format=json"

# Verify SMW data
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/rebuildData.php --page "BITwiki_Constitution"
```

=== 5.2 Set Up Categories

'''Create Category Pages:'''
```mediawiki
[[Category:BITwiki]]
[[Category:BITwiki Constitutional]]
[[Has description::Foundational principles and governance]]
```

'''Category Hierarchy:'''
* Category:BITwiki
* Category:BITwiki Constitutional
* Category:BITwiki Ontology
* Category:BITwiki Evidence-Epistemics
* Category:BITwiki Schema-Matter
* Category:BITwiki Governance
* Category:BITwiki Front-Matter
* Category:BITwiki Validation
* Category:BITwiki Research

=== 5.3 Configure Navigation

'''Main Page:'''
```mediawiki
= Welcome to BITwiki =

BITwiki is a recursive knowledge system for the age of distributed intelligence.

== Quick Start ==
* [[BITwiki_Start_Here|Start Here]]
* [[BITwiki_Constitution|Constitution]]
* [[BITwiki_Ontology_Index|Ontology]]
* [[BITwiki_Master_Navigation|Master Navigation]]

== Browse by Domain ==
{{#ask: [[Has domain::+]]
|?Has domain
|format=ul
}}

== Recent Changes ==
{{Special:RecentChanges}}
```

----
== 6. Quality Validation

=== 6.1 Run Validation Scripts

'''Epistemic Validation:'''
```bash
php maintenance/runEpistemicAudit.php \
  --min-confidence 0.8 \
  --output report.json
```

'''Template Validation:'''
```bash
php maintenance/checkTemplateUsage.php \
  --template "Infobox_Concept" \
  --verbose
```

'''Link Validation:'''
```bash
php maintenance/checkBrokenLinks.php \
  --namespace 0 \
  --output broken_links.txt
```

=== 6.2 Verify SMW Queries

'''Test Queries:'''
```mediawiki
{{#ask: [[Has epistemic status::Axiomatic]]
|?Has title
|format=ul
}}

{{#ask: [[Has confidence::>0.8]]
|?Has title
|?Has confidence
|format=table
}}
```

=== 6.3 Performance Check

'''Query Performance:'''
```bash
# Enable query profiling
$wgDebugToolbar = true;
$wgShowDebug = true;

# Check slow queries
tail -f /var/log/mediawiki/slow-queries.log
```

----
== 7. Post-Deployment Tasks

=== 7.1 Configure Backups

'''Automated Backup Script:'''
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# /opt/scripts/backup-bitwiki.sh

DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BACKUP_DIR="/backups/bitwiki"

# Database backup
mysqldump -u wikiuser -p'password' wikidb > $BACKUP_DIR/wiki_$DATE.sql

# Files backup
tar -czf $BACKUP_DIR/wiki_files_$DATE.tar.gz /var/www/html/wiki/

# SMW data export
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/exportRDF.php --file $BACKUP_DIR/wiki_$DATE.rdf

# Keep last 7 days
find $BACKUP_DIR -name "wiki_*.sql" -mtime +7 -delete
find $BACKUP_DIR -name "wiki_files_*.tar.gz" -mtime +7 -delete
find $BACKUP_DIR -name "wiki_*.rdf" -mtime +7 -delete
```

'''Cron Job:'''
```bash
# Daily at 2 AM
0 2 * * * /opt/scripts/backup-bitwiki.sh >> /var/log/bitwiki-backup.log 2>&1
```

=== 7.2 Set Up Monitoring

'''Log Monitoring:'''
```bash
# Watch for errors
tail -f /var/log/mediawiki/error.log | grep -i "error\|warning\|fatal"

# SMW specific
tail -f /var/log/mediawiki/smw.log
```

'''Performance Monitoring:'''
```bash
# Page load times
curl -w "@curl-format.txt" -o /dev/null -s https://bitwiki.org/Special:Statistics

# Query performance
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/smwadmin.php --queryprofiling
```

=== 7.3 Documentation

'''Update Documentation:'''
* [ ] Document deployment date and version
* [ ] Record configuration changes
* [ ] Update troubleshooting guide
* [ ] Notify stakeholders

----
== 8. Troubleshooting

=== 8.1 Common Issues

'''SMW Properties Not Showing:'''
```bash
# Rebuild semantic data
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/rebuildData.php -v

# Clear cache
php maintenance/purgeCache.php
```

'''Template Errors:'''
```bash
# Check template syntax
php maintenance/checkSyntax.php --file Template:Infobox_Concept.wiki

# Validate SMW in template
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/smwadmin.php --check
```

'''Slow Queries:'''
```bash
# Enable query cache
$smwgQueryResultCacheType = CACHE_ANYTHING;

# Optimize database
mysql -u root -p -e "OPTIMIZE TABLE smw_object_ids;"
```

=== 8.2 Rollback Procedure

'''Emergency Rollback:'''
```bash
# Stop web server
systemctl stop apache2

# Restore database
mysql -u wikiuser -p wikidb < backup_YYYYMMDD.sql

# Restore files
tar -xzf wiki_files_YYYYMMDD.tar.gz -C /var/www/html/

# Rebuild SMW
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/rebuildData.php

# Start web server
systemctl start apache2
```

----
== 9. Maintenance Schedule

| Task | Frequency | Command |
|------|-----------|---------|
| Database backup | Daily | `backup-bitwiki.sh` |
| SMW data rebuild | Weekly | `rebuildData.php` |
| Property statistics | Weekly | `updatePropertyStatistics.php` |
| Cache purge | Monthly | `purgeCache.php` |
| Link check | Monthly | `checkBrokenLinks.php` |
| Security updates | As needed | `git pull` |
| SMW update | Quarterly | Follow SMW upgrade guide |

----
== Conclusion

Successful BITwiki deployment requires careful planning, systematic execution, and ongoing maintenance. This guide provides the foundation for a robust, scalable knowledge system.

'''Success Metrics:'''
* All templates load without errors
* SMW queries return results < 2 seconds
* Epistemic markers display correctly
* Backup system operational
* Monitoring alerts functional

'''Next Steps:'''
# Complete deployment checklist
# Train content editors
# Establish content governance
# Monitor and optimize performance
# Plan for scaling

= BITwiki Deployment Guide: Production Implementation =

== Executive Summary

This guide provides step-by-step instructions for deploying BITwiki book matter to a production MediaWiki instance with Semantic MediaWiki (SMW) enabled.

'''Prerequisites:'''
* MediaWiki 1.39+ installed
* PHP 8.1+ with required extensions
* MySQL 8.0+ or PostgreSQL 13+
* SMW 4.1+ installed and configured
* Administrative access to wiki

----
== 1. Pre-Deployment Checklist

=== 1.1 System Requirements

| Component | Minimum | Recommended |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| PHP | 8.1 | 8.2 |
| MediaWiki | 1.39 | 1.41 |
| SMW | 4.1 | 4.1.1 |
| Database | MySQL 8.0 | MariaDB 10.6 |
| Memory | 2GB | 4GB |
| Storage | 10GB | 50GB |

=== 1.2 Required Extensions

'''Core Extensions:'''
* Semantic MediaWiki (SMW)
* ParserFunctions
* Cite
* SyntaxHighlight
* TemplateStyles

'''Recommended Extensions:'''
* VisualEditor
* WikiEditor
* CodeEditor
* ConfirmEdit (CAPTCHA)
* AbuseFilter

'''BITwiki-Specific:'''
* Semantic Forms (for structured input)
* Page Forms (for template-based editing)
* Header Tabs (for organized display)

=== 1.3 Backup Current System

```bash
# Backup database
mysqldump -u wikiuser -p wikidb > backup_$(date +%Y%m%d).sql

# Backup files
tar -czf wiki_files_$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz /var/www/html/wiki/

# Verify backups
ls -lh backup_*.sql wiki_files_*.tar.gz
```

----
== 2. SMW Configuration

=== 2.1 Enable SMW

'''LocalSettings.php:'''
```php
// Load SMW
wfLoadExtension( 'SemanticMediaWiki' );
enableSemantics( 'bitwiki.org' );

// SMW Settings
$smwgConfigFileDir = __DIR__ . '/data';
$smwgEnabledQueryFeatures = SMW_QUERY_ALL;
$smwgQMaxSize = 5000;
$smwgQMaxDepth = 10;
```

=== 2.2 Configure Property Types

'''Create Property: namespace pages:'''
```bash
# Run SMW setup
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/setupStore.php

# Rebuild data
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/rebuildData.php
```

=== 2.3 Optimize Performance

```php
// Enable query cache
$smwgQueryResultCacheType = CACHE_ANYTHING;
$smwgQueryResultCacheLifetime = 3600;

// Enable property statistics
$smwgPropertyStatistics = true;

// Configure job queue
$wgJobRunRate = 10;
```

== 3. Template Deployment

=== 3.1 Upload Templates

'''Method 1: Direct File Upload'''
```bash
# Copy template files
scp hyperion/book-matter/schema-matter/templates/*.wiki \
  user@server:/var/www/html/wiki/extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/import/

# Import via maintenance script
php maintenance/importTextFile.php \
  --title "Template:Infobox_Concept" \
  --overwrite \
  extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/import/Infobox_Concept.wiki
```

'''Method 2: Wiki Import'''
```bash
# Create XML dump
php maintenance/dumpBackup.php --current > templates.xml

# Import on target

```

== 7. Post-Deployment Tasks

=== 7.1 Configure Backups

'''Automated Backup Script:'''
```bash
#!/bin/bash
# /opt/scripts/backup-bitwiki.sh

DATE=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BACKUP_DIR="/backups/bitwiki"

# Database backup
mysqldump -u wikiuser -p'password' wikidb > $BACKUP_DIR/wiki_$DATE.sql

# Files backup
tar -czf $BACKUP_DIR/wiki_files_$DATE.tar.gz /var/www/html/wiki/

# SMW data export
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/exportRDF.php --file $BACKUP_DIR/wiki_$DATE.rdf

# Keep last 7 days
find $BACKUP_DIR -name "wiki_*.sql" -mtime +7 -delete
find $BACKUP_DIR -name "wiki_files_*.tar.gz" -mtime +7 -delete
find $BACKUP_DIR -name "wiki_*.rdf" -mtime +7 -delete
```

'''Cron Job:'''
```bash
# Daily at 2 AM
0 2 * * * /opt/scripts/backup-bitwiki.sh >> /var/log/bitwiki-backup.log 2>&1
```

=== 7.2 Set Up Monitoring

'''Log Monitoring:'''
```bash
# Watch for errors
tail -f /var/log/mediawiki/error.log | grep -i "error\|warning\|fatal"

# SMW specific
tail -f /var/log/mediawiki/smw.log
```

'''Performance Monitoring:'''

curl -w "@curl-format.txt" -o /dev/null -s https://bitwiki.org/Special:Statistics

```

== 8. Troubleshooting

=== 8.1 Common Issues

'''SMW Properties Not Showing:'''
```bash
# Rebuild semantic data
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/rebuildData.php -v

# Clear cache
php maintenance/purgeCache.php
```

'''Template Errors:'''
```bash
# Check template syntax
php maintenance/checkSyntax.php --file Template:Infobox_Concept.wiki

# Validate SMW in template
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/smwadmin.php --check
```

'''Slow Queries:'''
```bash
# Enable query cache
$smwgQueryResultCacheType = CACHE_ANYTHING;

# Optimize database
mysql -u root -p -e "OPTIMIZE TABLE smw_object_ids;"
```

=== 8.2 Rollback Procedure

'''Emergency Rollback:'''
```bash
# Stop web server
systemctl stop apache2

# Restore database
mysql -u wikiuser -p wikidb < backup_YYYYMMDD.sql

# Restore files
tar -xzf wiki_files_YYYYMMDD.tar.gz -C /var/www/html/

# Rebuild SMW
php extensions/SemanticMediaWiki/maintenance/rebuildData.php

# Start web server
systemctl start apache2
```
